nodes.label: Why Large Database Refactors Need Isolated Development Databases
nodes.rationale: Two branches with incompatible migration histories shouldn't write to the same database, even when their final schemas look alike; isolate divergent histories during development, then converge deliberately before release.

nodes.label: Migration History Isolation
nodes.rationale: Migration tools identify migrations by name and checksum, not by inferring whether two different sets of SQL files produce similar tables, so divergent histories must not share a database.
